name: Elsewhere Battles
summary:
Elsewhere Battles is a turn-based fantasy strategy game in which villagers gather resources and construct buildings while military units explore the map and fight rival civilizations. Players develop settlements, recruit armies and attack enemy towns.

The game offers offline solo battles against computer opponents and private-room online multiplayer with up to six civilizations. It is free to download with advertising and optional permanent purchases. The multiplayer preview includes maps and civilizations, while specialists and remix music follow purchases; solo unlocks remain separate.
